versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support modes Type: valid Description: The SW-Component template must provide some simple means to define modes. The name of the mode is the most important attribute that has to be provided Rationale: The assumption from the SW-Component point of view is that State Managers are using a Standardized AUTOSAR Interface to influence the SW-Component and also provide an interface to get requests and confirmations from the SW-Component.
